title: Part 2 应答问题
goal: 疑问词问句、一般疑问句、间接回答

steps.title: 仓库里的问答
lines: Where should we store the new inventory?
In the warehouse on Fifth Street.
Who's our main supplier for packaging?
我们的包装材料主要供应商是谁？
You'd better check with Ms. Lee in purchasing.
你最好问问采购部的李女士。
steps.note: Part 2 一共 25 题，每题一句问话 + 三个回答，没有任何文字。WH 问句约占三分之一，听清第一个词就答对了一半。

steps.title: 疑问词决定答案类型
what: Who → 人名、职位、部门（Ms. Lee / the manager / Accounting）
When → 时间（next week / by Friday / not until…）；Where → 地点（in the warehouse / on the desk）
Why → 原因（Because… / To…/ 或直接给理由）；How → 方式、程度（by courier / very well）
How long / How often / How many / How much → 时长、频率、数量、价格
why: 只要听清第一个词，就能排除“信息类型对不上”的选项：问 When 答地点的、问 Where 答时间的，直接排除。
带 Yes / No 的回答对 WH 问句一定是错的。
zh: 中文疑问词在句中（货什么时候到？），英语在句首（When will…），所以要训练“开头那一个词”的反应。
ex: When will the shipment arrive? — Not until next week.
货什么时候到？——要到下周。
Where's the tracking number? — It's on the receipt.
追踪号在哪儿？——在收据上。
err: Where is the warehouse? — Yes, it's big.
Where is the warehouse? — On Fifth Street.
WH 问句不用 Yes 回答
When does it open? — In the lobby.
When does it open? — At nine.
When 要答时间
steps.sum: 抓开头疑问词 → 只找对应的信息类型；带 Yes / No 的直接排除。

steps.title: 间接回答：“问问某某”“我查一下”也是正确答案
what: I'll check. / Let me look it up.（我查一下）
You'd better ask Ms. Lee. / Check with the supplier.（问问某人）
It hasn't been decided yet. / I'm not sure.（还没定 / 不清楚）
why: 新 TOEIC 越来越多用这种“不直接回答”的正确选项。它们能回答任何问句，所以当另外两个选项明显错时，大胆选它。
zh: 中文日常也这么说：“你问一下王经理吧”。英语考试里这就是标准答案。
ex: Where is the order form? — Let me look for it.
订货单在哪儿？——我找找看。
When will the price change? — It hasn't been announced yet.
价格什么时候变？——还没公布。
err: Who is our new distributor? — The distributor is new.
Who is our new distributor? — Ask Mr. Patel in sales.
重复词的选项多半是陷阱
steps.sum: I'll check / Ask Ms. … / It hasn't been decided —— 万能的间接回答。

lessons.title: 一般疑问句与否定疑问句

steps.title: 订货问题
lines: They've been dispatched, but they're on backorder.
已经发货了，不过是延期交货。
Haven't we placed the purchase order yet?
The catalog prices are the same as last year, aren't they?
目录价格和去年一样，对吧？
Actually, a few items went up.
steps.note: 一般疑问句可以用 Yes / No 回答，但 Part 2 的正确答案经常“绕开”Yes / No，直接给信息。

steps.title: 一般疑问句：正确答案常常不说 Yes / No
what: 问：Did… / Is… / Have you… / Can…?
直接答：Yes, … / No, …
绕开答（更常考）：Did the parcel arrive? → It's on your desk.（= 到了）
why: 出题人喜欢把 Yes 放在错误选项里（Yes + 后面答非所问），把正确答案做成“不说 Yes 但意思是 Yes”的句子。所以不能听到 Yes 就选。
zh: 中文也常这么答：“货到了吗？”“在你桌上。”—— 把这种自然对话的感觉带进英语。
ex: Is the catalog ready? — The printer is working on it now.
目录好了吗？——印刷厂正在印。
Can you restock the shelves? — I'll do it after lunch.
你能补一下货架吗？——午饭后我来弄。
err: Did you send the parcel? — Yes, the post office is closed.
Did you send the parcel? — I sent it this morning.
Yes 后面要切题
steps.sum: 听完整句：Yes / No 后面切不切题；不说 Yes 的“绕开答”常是正确答案。

steps.title: 否定疑问句、反义疑问句：当普通问句听
what: Haven't we placed the order? = Have we placed the order?
The prices went up, didn't they? = Did the prices go up?
事实是肯定 → Yes（或直接给肯定信息）；事实是否定 → No
why: 中文“我们还没下单吗？”回答“下了”要说 Yes, we did，不能按中文习惯说“No（不，下了）”。最简单的办法：忽略否定词，当普通问句。
zh: 这是中国学生最容易反着答的地方：Isn't it ready? — 准备好了 → Yes, it is.
ex: Isn't the postage included? — No, it's extra.
邮费不包含吗？——不包含，另算。
You've checked the order form, haven't you? — Yes, everything's correct.
你核对过订货单了吧？——核对了，都对。
err: Didn't you get my e-mail? — No, I read it.（意思是收到了）
Yes, I read it.
收到了就答 Yes
steps.sum: 去掉否定词再理解；事实肯定答 Yes，否定答 No。

steps.title: 客服电话
lines: Would you like a refund or a replacement?
A replacement, please. The warranty hasn't expired yet.
Should we send it by mail, or will you pick it up?
我们是邮寄，还是您来取？
We're sorry for the inconvenience. Here's a voucher for your next order.
给您带来不便很抱歉。这是下次订单可用的优惠券。
steps.note: 选择疑问句 A or B? 有固定的几种正确答案，掌握了几乎不会错。

steps.title: 选择疑问句：不能用 Yes / No
what: A or B? 的正确答案常见四种：
① 选一个：The second one, please.
② 都行：Either is fine. / I don't mind.
③ 都不要 / 第三种：Neither, thanks. / Actually, I'd prefer C.
④ 间接：Would you like tea or coffee? — I just had some.
why: 一听到 or，就把所有 Yes / No 开头的选项划掉，剩下的里再找。
zh: 中文“都可以”最常用，英语对应 Either is fine / Either one works；“都不要”是 Neither。
ex: Do you want to pay now or later? — Now is fine.
您现在付还是以后付？——现在吧。
Monday or Tuesday? — Neither works for me. How about Wednesday?
周一还是周二？——都不行，周三怎么样？
err: Refund or replacement? — Yes, please.
A refund, please.
选择疑问句不能答 Yes
steps.sum: 听到 or → 排除 Yes / No；Either / Neither / 选一个 / 第三种。

steps.title: 客服英语：道歉、补偿、保修
what: 道歉：We apologize for the inconvenience. / Sorry for any inconvenience.
补偿：compensate sb for sth；a voucher（代金券）、complimentary（免费赠送的）
保修：The warranty expires in May. / It's still under warranty.
why: Part 3 / 4 / 7 的客服场景里，问题常是“What does the company offer?”—— 答案就是 voucher / discount / complimentary 之类的补偿。
zh: complimentary 是“免费赠送的”，和 compliment（称赞）只差一个字母，Part 5 常考。
ex: Breakfast is complimentary for all guests.
所有住客免费享用早餐。
We'll compensate you for the delay.
我们会为延误给您补偿。
Is the camera still under warranty?
这台相机还在保修期内吗？
err: We will compensate the delay to you.
We will compensate you for the delay.
compensate sb for sth
The drinks are complementary.
The drinks are complimentary.
免费的是 complimentary
steps.sum: apologize for the inconvenience；compensate sb for sth；complimentary = 免费；under warranty。

steps.title: IT 支持
lines: Yes, twice. I think there's a glitch in the new software.
试了两次。我觉得新软件有个故障。
Why don't you call the help desk?
你为什么不打电话给技术支持？
Good idea. Could you give me the number?
好主意。你能给我号码吗？
Sure, it's in the user manual.
steps.note: 陈述句（My computer keeps freezing.）没有疑问词，是 Part 2 最难的题型；Why don't you… 则看起来像问原因，其实是建议。

steps.title: 陈述句：找最自然的反应
what: 陈述一个问题 → 回答给解决办法：The copier is jammed. — I'll call the technician.
陈述一个消息 → 回答反应或追问：We got the contract! — That's great news. / When do we start?
陈述计划 → 回答相关安排：I'm leaving early today. — Don't forget to lock the door.
why: 陈述句没有“标准答案类型”，只能靠“像不像真实对话”。先用排除法：重复词、近音词、答非所问的先划掉。
zh: 中文对话里我们本能就会这样接话，英语考试考的正是这种“接话能力”。
ex: The server is down again. — I'll let IT know.
服务器又宕机了。——我去告诉 IT 部门。
I forgot my password. — You can reset it online.
我忘了密码。——你可以在网上重置。
err: The printer is out of paper. — I printed it yesterday.
The printer is out of paper. — There's some in the supply closet.
要给解决办法，不是重复词
steps.sum: 陈述问题 → 办法；消息 → 反应 / 追问；计划 → 相关安排。

steps.title: 请求、建议、提议：看意图，不看字面
what: Why don't you / we…? = 建议（不是问原因！）→ Good idea. / I'd love to, but…
Could you…? / Would you mind…? = 请求 → Sure. / Not at all.
Would you like me to…? / Shall I…? = 主动帮忙 → That'd be great. / Thanks, but I can manage.
why: Why don't we… 后面选 Because… 的，100% 是陷阱。这是 Part 2 每套必考的题。
zh: 中文“你干嘛不……”也是建议的意思，英语同理 —— 只是考试里故意用 Because 来骗你。
ex: Why don't we back up the files tonight? — Sure, I'll stay late.
我们今晚备份文件吧？——好，我留下来。
Shall I call the technician? — Yes, please.
要我叫技术员吗？——好，麻烦了。
err: Why don't you reboot the computer? — Because it's broken.
Why don't you reboot the computer? — I already tried that.
Why don't you = 建议
steps.sum: Why don't you / we = 建议，排除 Because；Shall I / Would you like me to = 主动帮忙。

It is. And there's a shuttle from the airport to the hotel.

steps.note: 最后一课：把四大陷阱和两种万能答案放在一起，做一组完整的 Part 2 练习。

steps.title: Part 2 四大陷阱
what: ① 重复词：问 flight，选项里也有 flight —— 多半是错的
② 近音词：fare / fair、boarding / bored、check in / chicken
③ 联想词：问机场，选项说 pilot、ticket —— 话题相关但答非所问
④ 时态错位：问将来（Will you…），选项答过去（I went…）
why: 四种陷阱都是“听起来像对的”。对策是：听问句时抓意图（问时间？问地点？请求？），再用意图检验每个选项。
zh: 中国考生最常栽在①和③：听到熟悉的词就觉得对。记住 Part 2 有一条反规律：和问句用词越像的选项越可疑。
ex: What's the fare to the airport? — About thirty dollars.
去机场的车费是多少？——大概三十美元。
Where's the baggage claim? — Downstairs, near exit B.
行李提取处在哪儿？——楼下，B 出口附近。
err: What's the fare to the airport? — The fair is next week.
About thirty dollars.
fare / fair 近音陷阱
When will you check in? — I checked in yesterday.
Around three o'clock.
时态错位
steps.sum: 重复词、近音词、联想词、时态错位 —— 越像问句的越可疑。

steps.title: “我也不确定”型回答
what: I'm not sure yet. / It hasn't been decided.
Let me check. / I'll find out.
It depends on the weather. / That's up to the manager.
why: 这类回答看上去“没回答”，却是 Part 2 最常见的正确答案之一，任何类型的问句都可以接。另外两个选项都有明显问题时，就选它。
zh: 中文也常说“还没定”“看情况”“得问经理”。
ex: When is the conference? — The dates haven't been announced.
会议什么时候开？——日期还没公布。
Which hotel are we staying at? — That's up to the travel agency.
我们住哪家酒店？——那得看旅行社。
err: Is the flight on time? — The flight is long.
Is the flight on time? — Let me check the board.
重复词陷阱 vs 不确定型正解
steps.sum: I'm not sure / Let me check / It depends / That's up to …

steps.title: A Defective Order
steps.note: TOEIC Part 7 式的阅读：先看题目再读文章，带着问题找答案。先关掉译文读。
lines: To: Customer Service, Brightway Office Supplies
收件人：Brightway 办公用品公司客服部
I'm writing about the order I placed on May 3.
我写信是关于我 5 月 3 日下的订单。
The shipment arrived yesterday, but two of the ten desk lamps are defective. They do not turn on.
货昨天到了，但十盏台灯中有两盏是坏的，打不开。
Also, one box was marked "fragile," but it was damaged when it arrived.
另外，有一个箱子标着“易碎”，到货时却已经破损。
Could you send two replacements as soon as possible? We need them for a new office that opens on May 20.
能否尽快寄两盏替换的？5 月 20 日开业的新办公室要用。
给您带来不便，我们深表歉意。
Two replacement lamps were dispatched this morning by express courier, and your tracking number is BW-2281.
两盏替换台灯已于今早通过快递寄出，追踪号为 BW-2281。
You do not need to return the defective items.
您无需退回有问题的商品。
To compensate you for the trouble, we have also attached a voucher for 15% off your next order.
为补偿给您带来的麻烦，我们还附上了一张下次订单八五折的优惠券。

steps.q: Why did Mr. Ross write the first e-mail?
o: Some items he received were defective.
He wanted to cancel an order.

steps.q: When does the new office open?
What does the company ask Mr. Ross to do with the defective lamps?
steps.e: You do not need to return the defective items.

steps.q: What does the company offer Mr. Ross?
o: A discount on his next order
steps.e: a voucher for 15% off your next order —— 同义替换成 discount。

steps.q: The word "dispatched" is closest in meaning to

steps.zh: 给您带来不便，我们深表歉意。
a: We apologize for the inconvenience.
We are sorry for the inconvenience.

points: Part 7 双邮件：先读第一封抓问题，再在第二封里找解决办法。
同义替换：dispatched = sent；voucher for 15% off = discount。
